evals.prompt: Save this note in my KM: Docker containers on the same bridge network can resolve each other by container name.
evals.expected_output: Select km-organizer because the requested outcome is durable storage and organization.
assertions: Names km-organizer as the primary destination skill.
Does not route based only on the Docker topic.

evals.prompt: Summarize the latest official Nushell configuration guidance and compare it with what this KM repo already says.
evals.expected_output: Select research as primary because current internet research plus KM cross-checking is requested.
assertions: Names research as the primary destination skill.
Does not create a redundant indexing-folder primary workflow.

evals.prompt: Where does this repository document zsh setup? Give me the exact files and lines.
evals.expected_output: Select indexing-folder for map-first repository routing and exact confirmation.
assertions: Names indexing-folder as the primary destination skill.
Preserves the request for exact source confirmation.

evals.prompt: Review docs/plans/new-search-plan.md and simplify anything unnecessary, but do not implement it.
evals.expected_output: Select useful-skill because the requested outcome is plan review before implementation.
assertions: Names useful-skill as the primary destination skill.
Does not route to managing-feature-plans merely because the input is a plan.

evals.prompt: Create a project-local skill that routes pasted information to the correct workflow.
evals.expected_output: Select skill-creator because the requested outcome is creating an agent skill.
assertions: Names skill-creator as the primary destination skill.

evals.prompt: Here are my API credentials and some setup notes.
evals.expected_output: Do not infer permission to store the content; ask for the intended outcome if work cannot proceed safely.
assertions: Does not persist or repeat credential-like content.
Does not treat pasted information as automatic authorization to save.

evals.prompt: Install zoxide and starship integration for Nushell.
evals.expected_output: Select nushell-install-utils rather than the Bash/Zsh installer.
assertions: Names nushell-install-utils as the primary destination skill.
Uses the target shell to resolve the overlap.

evals.prompt: Research current tmux defaults, then save a concise verified note into this KM repository.
evals.expected_output: Select research as primary, followed by km-organizer as an ordered second stage.
assertions: Names research as the primary destination skill.
Names km-organizer as the later storage stage.
Does not treat routing as authorization to bypass either skill's workflow.
